rules.why: hands swing forward over the water
arms nearly straight on the recovery

text.action: a swimmer swimming butterfly, both arms swinging forward over the water
text.core: Prone at the surface with the shoulders just out of the water; both arms swinging forward together low over the water, straight at the elbows, palms facing back and down; head down between the arms with the face toward the water; hips at the surface; legs together, knees slightly bent in the dolphin kick, toes pointed.
text.gaze: Eyes down and slightly forward, just above the water.
cues: both arms move together and at the same time
arms low and relaxed over the water
head goes down before the hands enter
kinetic: turbulence from the dolphin kick behind
avoid: swimmer standing on the pool floor
body floating high out of the water
hair floating without a swim cap
one arm forward and one arm back
